name: XCC_BCE_BUSINESS_FUNCTIONS
description: This table holds the enablement information for Budgetary Control and Encumbrance Accounting for the business function level. It depends on the business flows covered by a business unit and ledger. During Business Unit Enablement we will insert a row for every Business Function attached to the Procure To Pay flow and one for the Project Accounting business function.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Corresponds to the business unit identifier.

columns.name: BUSINESS_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: It is the identifier of the business functions

columns.name: BUSINESS_FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the business flow, either Procure To Pay or Project Expenditure Items.

columns.name: BC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Budgetary Control Enablement indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: EA_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Encumbrance Accounting Enablement indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: PARTIAL_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.description: Partial Reservation Allowed indicator. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: RESERVE_ON_SUBMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Reservation On Submit indicator. Setting to No means that reservation is done on Approval. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
